name: aivenue
description: Orchestrate subscription-based AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Qwen, ...) as planners, executors, reviewers and sub-agents.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/bridge && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p packages/desktop && tsc -p packages/vscode
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/build.mjs && npm run package:linux -w @aivenue/desktop && node scripts/package-linux.mjs
scripts.package:vscode: node scripts/build.mjs && npm run package -w aivenue-vscode
